description: Fixed 7-field incident schema. Every field written by the Extractor Agent must carry an evidence_status. The Clarification Agent uses clarification_question + input options for any field left NOT_PROVIDED. Never invent a value — see evidence_statuses.

evidence_statuses.SUPPORTED: The value is directly and clearly stated in the transcript.
evidence_statuses.NOT_PROVIDED: The transcript does not mention this field. Leave value as null. Do not guess.
evidence_statuses.CONFLICTING: The transcript contains contradictory information for this field. Flag for human review.
evidence_statuses.INFERRED: The system reasoned this out rather than reading it directly. Must be clearly labeled as inferred, never presented as fact.

fields.name: location
fields.extractor_hint: Where on the site is this happening? e.g. 'Block B', 'Slab 3, East Wing'

fields.name: issue
fields.extractor_hint: One short phrase describing the problem, e.g. 'Equipment problem', 'Material shortage'
fields.clarification_question: What's the issue, in a few words?

fields.name: equipment
fields.extractor_hint: Name of the equipment involved, if any, e.g. 'Concrete Pump'
fields.clarification_question: Which equipment is involved, if any?

fields.name: severity
fields.extractor_hint: Only set this if severity is stated or extremely obvious from context — otherwise leave NOT_PROVIDED and let the Clarification Agent ask.

fields.name: emergency
fields.extractor_hint: Only set this if explicitly stated or unmistakably implied (e.g. injury, fire, structural collapse).

fields.name: duration
fields.extractor_hint: How long has this been going on, if mentioned.
fields.clarification_question: Approximately how long has this been happening?

fields.name: impact
fields.extractor_hint: Effect on ongoing work, if mentioned.
fields.clarification_question: What is the impact on work?

example_gold_record.transcript: Block B mein concrete pump ka problem hai.
